bio.text: Aurora Stuski is the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
According to her campaign website, she has lived in West Norriton since moving from Philadelphia in 1987, and she founded and owns AAS Appraisal Lab, which has served Montgomery County since 1989.
The campaign site says she has chaired the West Norriton Republican Committee since 2024.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Arcadia University (1988).
